IS : 9385 ( Part 5 ) - 1983

Indian Standard
SPECIFICATION FOR HIGH VOLTAGE FUSES
PART 5 TYPES AND DIMENSIONS OF FUSE-LINKS FUSES FOR CURRENT-LIMITING

0.

FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part 5 ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 25 *July 1983, after the draft finalized by the High Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division .Council. 0.2 This standard is one among the series of standards intended to cover The the various aspects of fuses intended for voltages above 1 000 V. other parts in the series are: Part 1 Part 2 Part 3 Part 4 Current-limiting Explusion Application fuses fuses and similar fuses guide for high voltage fuses power factor for testing of

Determination of short-circuit high voltage fuses

0.3 Requirements and tests for high voltage fuses of the current-limiting type are covered comprehensively in IS : 9385 ( Part 1 )-1979*. This standard ( Part 5 ) ia intended to cover types and tlimensions of fuselinks for current-limiting fuses aimed as the first step towards variety reduction and dimensional interchangeability. 0.4 As it was attempted in the area of low voltage HBC fuses in the preliminary stages, it has been possible at the IEC level to collect and classify only the types of dimensions officially specified on the various The contents of this standard ( Part 5 ) existing national standards. therefore closely follow those in 1EC Pub 282.1A ( 1978 ), .`Types and dimensions of current-limiting fuse-links specified in existing national standards', first supplement to Publication 282-l( 1974 ) `High-voltage fuses: Part 1 Current-limiting fuses', published by the International Eiectrotechnical Commission, in order to keep the Indian industry *Specification for high voltage,fuses:
Part 1 Current limiting fuses.

3

IS : 9385 ( Part 5 ) - 1983
informed of efforts devoted to standardization of dimensions of high voltage fuse-links as well as to encourage them to achieve a reduction in the number of types. As soon as it is possible to achieve dimensional standardization on a world-wide basis, efforts would be made to review the contents of this standard. 0.5 This standard corresponds appreciably with the IEC Publication referred to in 0.4 and there are no major differences. 0.6 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : z-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard covers types and dimensions of fuse-links for currentlimiting fuses.
1.2 In respect of requirements other than dimensions, the provisions of IS : 9385 ( Part 1 )-1979t shall apply. 2. %YPES AND DIMENSIONS

2.1 Three types of fuse-links, I, II and III are defined in this standard according to the dimensions shown in the data sheets I, II and III.
